one_line: The paper empirically analyses Italian mandatory energy audits of the rubber manufacturing industry (tyres and other rubber products, NACE C22.1) to compute energy performance indicators and evaluate efficiency interventions; listed Corpus-B sectors (steel, pulp & paper, oil refinery) appear only as literature-review citations of prior methodology applications.
